name: web-multi-level-accordion-faq-component-on-dotted-white
title: Bordered FAQ accordion with nested sub-questions in a grey inset, on a dotted white ground
whatItIs: A white component card titled 'Multi-level' with six question rows separated by hairlines and chevrons, where one open row reveals a nested question list in a grey inset with its own chevrons and a short answer.
whatItMeans: Clear and quiet; grey insets show hierarchy without extra colour.
techniques: Nest sub-accordions inside an open item.
Use chevrons that flip when open.
